detail.longDescription: This is a bit of a tongue-in-cheek. Since reading the "We need smart people who give a shit" story (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50554045), and the comments underneath it, I realise that there is a good deal of engineers who are disgruntled by how AI is incompatible with smart people who give a shit, how it is turning us into meat proxies and Letzter Mensch. So this is a call for companies and employers with smart management who still give a shit, who do not demand that engineers replace their workflow with 5 parallel agent sessions, who appreciate the craftsmanship of humans, to step forward and post their job openings.
